# vvm_datastore (Resource)

A VVM datastore (`/v1/datastores`): the shared storage a cluster's VMs keep their disks on.

Two modes, and exactly one of them:

  * **provision** — set `size_gib`. VVM makes the VPC File Share and its mount target.
  * **adopt** — set `file_share_id`. You already have a share; VVM mounts it.

`terraform apply` returns when the control plane reports the datastore `Active`, which means a host has actually mounted it — not merely that the share exists. Every attribute is immutable: a change destroys and recreates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Provision mode: VVM makes the VPC File Share and mounts it on every host.
resource "vvm_datastore" "app" {
  cluster_id = var.cluster_id
  name       = "app-ds"
  mount_path = "/mnt/vvm/app"
  size_gib   = 100
  zone       = "eu-gb-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster this datastore belongs to.
- `mount_path` (String) Absolute path each host mounts the share at, e.g. `/mnt/vvm/bulk`. Required in both modes, and the control plane refuses one that is not absolute.
- `name` (String) Name of the datastore. Required when provisioning.

### Optional

- `create_timeout` (String) How long `terraform apply` waits for this resource to reach its target state, as a Go duration (e.g. `45m`). Default `45m`. On timeout the error carries the state the control plane last reported and the state of the job behind it.
- `delete_timeout` (String) How long `terraform destroy` waits for this resource to be gone, as a Go duration. Default `30m`.
- `encryption_kp_key_id` (String) Key Protect key the share is encrypted with. Omit for the platform default.
- `file_share_id` (String) **Adopt mode.** Id of an existing VPC File Share. Mutually exclusive with `size_gib`.
- `iops` (Number) IOPS to provision. Omit to take the platform default, which is derived from the size. The permitted range depends on both the size and the profile.
- `size_gib` (Number) **Provision mode.** Size of the share VVM creates, in GiB. Mutually exclusive with `file_share_id`. Grow it afterwards through the API; a change here destroys and recreates, which would lose the data on it.
- `storage_class` (String) Share profile VVM provisions with.
- `zone` (String) VPC zone the share is created in, e.g. `eu-gb-1`.

### Read-Only

- `actual_state` (String) The state the control plane has OBSERVED, reconciled against reality. `terraform plan` shows a change here when the datastore was changed outside Terraform.
- `capacity_gb` (Number) The capacity the control plane has MEASURED, in GB. A reading, not an instruction: it tracks the share as it really is, so a grow made outside Terraform shows up here on the next plan.
- `desired_state` (String) The state the control plane is working towards.
- `id` (String) UUID the control plane minted for this datastore.
- `job_id` (String) The asynchronous job the create emitted. Named in the error when a create or a delete runs out of time, so the real job state is what the operator sees.
- `updated_at` (String) When the row last changed, as the API reported it. Used as the `If-Match` precondition on a delete; it is re-read immediately before the delete is sent, because the row's timestamp moves on its own.
